description: This file defines the 'XPoint' struct, a fundamental data structure representing a 2D point with floating-point coordinates in the PDFsharp library. It includes constructors, properties, and methods for parsing, string conversion, arithmetic operations, and interoperability with platform-specific point types.

classes.name: XPoint
classes.description: A struct representing a 2D point with double precision, including methods for parsing, comparison, conversion, and arithmetic operations within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create an XPoint object.

methods.name: ParsePoints
methods.description: Parses a string containing multiple points separated by spaces into an array of XPoint objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the point, following the specified format and culture.

methods.name: Offset
methods.description: Offsets the point by specified x and y deltas.
